source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cell-mediated and antibody-mediated immunity (PDF 177-182).

blocks.text: Jaraseem ke hamle par macrophages unhein nigal kar foran jawab dete hain. Yeh bohat se jaraseem khatam nahi kar sakta lekin immune system ko jawab ka waqt deta hai. Jaraseem nigalne wala macrophage helper T cells ke liye khaas proteins bhi banata hai; jab helper T cells apne receptors se inhein pehchante hain to chalu ho kar do mutawazi jawab shuru karte hain: cell-mediated immunity aur antibody-mediated immunity.

Cell-mediated immunity, jo T cells karte hain, ghair maamooli ya virus zada cells maar kar virus infections aur cancer se bachati hai. Cytotoxic T cells infected jismani cells pehchan kar tabah karte hain, natural killer cells ki tarah target cells ki membranes chhed kar.

items: Proliferation: chalu helper T cell T cell growth factor jaise ghulne wale kimiyai maadde banata hai jo har qisam ke T cells ko antigen pehchanne wale bare clones mein barhata hai.
Activation: helper T cell ka doosra factor macrophages ko infection ki jagah bulata hai.
Induction: helper T cells thymus mein inducer T cells chalu karte hain jo lymphocytes ko T cells mein pukhta karte hain.
Attack: cytotoxic T cells ke receptors infected jismani cells pehchante hain; T cells un se jur kar membranes torte aur cells phat jate hain.
Suppression: suppressor T cells cytotoxic jawab rokte hain. Yeh dheere barhte hain, is liye shuru mein hamla nahi rok sakte, lekin 1 se 2 hafte baad itne ho jate hain ke use band kar dein.
Memory: helper aur cytotoxic T cells ki aabadi, memory cells, shayad umr bhar rehti aur jaraseem se baad ki har mulaqat par tez jawab deti hai.

blocks.alt: Shaakhon wala silsila. Macrophage ke banaye proteins helper T-cell mein waqiyat shuru karte; yeh activated helper T-cell ban kar ghulne wale maadde (soluble factors) chhorta. Teen shaakhein: macrophage ko infected cell ki taraf khenchna; T-cells ki afzaish; aur inducer T-cell jis se lymphocytes T-cells mein pukhta hote. Barhe hue T-cells se cytotoxic T-cells (infected cell par hamla), suppressor T-cells (jawab rokna) aur memory cells (aainda ke liye) bante.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sab kuch macrophage se shuru hota hai: us ke proteins helper T-cell ko chalu karte hain. Chalu helper T-cell ke maadde teen kaam karte hain: macrophage ko infected cell ki taraf bulate hain, T-cells ki ginti barhate hain, aur inducer T-cell ke zariye naye T-cells pukhta karte hain. Barhe hue T-cells teen kaam baant lete hain: cytotoxic (maarna), suppressor (rokna) aur memory (yaad rakhna).

Chalu helper T cell doosra, zyada taqatwar difa bhi chalu karta hai, antibody-mediated ya humoral immunity, jis ke asal khiladi B cells hain. B cells antigens par seedha hamla nahi karte; un par tabahi ka nishan lagate aur zehreele molecules ko bhi bekaar karte hain.

items: Proliferation: har B cell apni satah ke B receptor proteins se antigen pakarta hai; helper T cells in B cells se jur kar aise proteins chhorte hain jo unhein bohat se plasma cells mein barhate hain.

Differentiation aur secretion: zyada tar plasma cells afzaish rok kar mazeed B receptor proteins banate hain jo chhore jate aur ab antibodies kehlate hain; plasma cells chand dinon mein bohat bari tadaad mein antibodies chhorte hain.

Attack: antibodies antigen par teen mein se kisi tareeqe tabahi ka nishan lagati hain: kuch complement proteins chalu karti jo antibody lipte cell mein soorakh karte, paani andar jata aur woh phat jata; kuch ko macrophages pehchan kar antigen nigal lete; aur killer cells, NK cells jaise lekin antibody lipte antigens ke receptors wale, unhein pakar kar maarte hain.
Suppression: kai hafton baad suppressor T cells antibody jawab band kar dete hain.
Memory: chalu B cells ke clone ke kuch arakeen antibodies nahi banate; yeh memory B cells ban kar bache rehte aur usi antigen se baad ki har mulaqat par tez doosra (secondary) jawab dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke memory B cells 'plasma cells ke clone' ke un arakeen se bante hain jo antibodies nahi banate. Yeh sahi nahi: plasma cell aakhri darje ka cell hai jo sirf antibodies banata hai, memory cell nahi banta. Antigen se chalu hone wale B cell ka clone do qism ke cells deta hai: plasma cells (antibodies banane wale) aur memory B cells. Is liye yahan 'B cells ka clone' likha gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Primary response: antigen aik munasib B cell ke B receptor proteins se jurte; helper T cell is se jurta aur afzaish se plasma cells bante jo antibody molecules chhorte, aur aik memory B cell. Usi antigen se dobara saamna: secondary response, jis mein memory B cell bohat zyada plasma cells, kahin zyada antibodies aur naye memory B cells deta.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Primary response, Antigen, B receptor protein on a B cell, Antigen bound to a B cell, Helper T cell, Proliferation, Plasma cell, Antibody molecules, Memory B cell, Later encounter with the same antigen, Secondary response.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehli dafa (primary response) sirf thore plasma cells aur antibodies bante hain, magar memory B cell bhi banta hai. Usi antigen se doosri dafa (secondary response) yahi memory B cell foran bohat zyada plasma cells aur antibodies banata hai; isi liye doosra jawab tez aur taqatwar hota hai. Antibodies antigen ko apne baazuon ke siron (binding sites) se pakarti hain.

blocks.title: Vaccines aur antibodies
blocks.text: Vaccine, jo maare ya kamzor kiye jaraseem se banti hai, antibodies banwati aur memory cells banati hai. Antibodies khoon ke plasma ke kul protein ka wazan ke lehaaz se taqreeban 20% hain.

blocks.title: Immune system aur gene therapy
blocks.text: Malignant melanoma jaan lewa jild ka cancer hai. Tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) rasoliyon par hamla karte lekin unhein qaboo karne ke liye kaafi taqatwar nahi. Kitab TILs mein aisa gene dalne ki koshish bayan karti hai jis se woh tumour necrosis factor (TNF), rasoli ke cells maarne wala protein, banayein, aur phir unhein mareez ke khoon mein wapas dala jaye taa ke woh rasoli mein jayen.

Antibody chaar polypeptide chains ka Y shakal ka protein hai, do aik jaisi lambi (heavy) aur do chhoti (light) chains, jo disulfide pulon se jori hain. Har chain ka constant region, aik class ki sab antibodies mein milta julta, aur variable region hota hai jo antibodies mein mukhtalif hai. Y ke har baazu par aik heavy aur aik light chain ke variable regions makhsoos binding site banate hain. Kyunke mukhtalif antibodies ke variable regions mukhtalif hain, antibodies makhsoos hain: har aik usi antigen ko tabah karti hai jis ne use banwaya.

blocks.alt: Y shakal ki antibody. Do heavy chains tana aur har baazu ka andaruni hissa banati hain; har baazu ke bairooni taraf aik light chain. Har chain ka sira variable region (sabz) hai, baqi constant region (narangi). Disulfide pul dono heavy chains ko aur har light chain ko us ki heavy chain se jorte hain. Bracket dono baazuon ke siron par binding sites dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.14: Antibody ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 21.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Binding sites, Variable region, Constant region, Disulfide bridge, Light chain, Heavy chains.

blocks.text: Antigen molecule ka sirf chhota hissa, us ka determinant, antibody ki binding site mein fit hota hai. Jab bohat si mukhtalif antibodies aik antigen se, har aik us ki satah ke mukhtalif hisse par, jurti hain to woh polyclonal antibodies hain. Sirf aik determinant se jurne wali antibodies monoclonal antibodies hain.

1984 mein Cesar Milstein aur Georges Kohler ko monoclonal antibodies banana seekhne par Nobel Prize mila. Unhon ne antibody banane wale plasma cells ko myelomas naam ke cancer cells se milaya aur naye barhte aur taqseem hote cells, hybridomas, paye jo plasma cell ke genes se antibodies aur myeloma ke genes se barhne aur taqseem hone ka kaam karte the. Hybridomas wahi antibody banate rahe jis ka un ka plasma cell mahir tha.

blocks.alt: Choohe mein antigen ka teeka, us ki tilli se plasma cells (B cells). Cancer cells (myelomas) culture mein ugaye jate. Dono test tube mein milaye jate jahan cells jur kar hybridomas bante, aur hybridoma culture monoclonal antibodies banata.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.15: Monoclonal antibodies (kitab ki Figure 21.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Antigen injected into mouse, Plasma cells (B cells) from spleen, Cancer cells (myelomas) grown in culture, Cells fused to produce hybridomas, Hybridoma cell culture producing monoclonal antibodies.

blocks.text: Monoclonal antibodies is liye ahem hain ke yeh paicheeda mixtures se khaas molecules saaf kar sakti hain; interferon isi tarah saaf kiya gaya. Tib mein yeh khaas ilaaj pohanchane ki sawari ke taur par use hoti hain, aur sirf cancer cells par paye jane wale antigens par tehqeeq jaari hai jin par radioactive monoclonal antibodies nishana bana kar sirf cancer cells maar sakti hain.

blocks.prompt: Vaccine saalon tak kyun bachati hai jab ke di gayi antibodies thori der?
blocks.explanation: Vaccine jism se apne memory B aur T cells banwati hai jo baad ke infection par tez jawab dete hain; di gayi antibodies bas khatam ho jati aur koi memory cells nahi bante.

items: Helper T cells cell-mediated (T cells) aur antibody-mediated (B cells) immunity shuru karte.
CMI: proliferation, activation, induction, attack, suppression, memory.
AMI: plasma cells antibodies chhorte; complement, macrophages ya killer cells tabah karte; memory B cells.
Antibody: 2 heavy + 2 light chains, variable binding sites; hybridomas se monoclonal antibodies.
